blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecutors in the International Criminal Court (ICC) are asking that the old written accounts of three more witnesses be admitted as evidence as they hold key information on “Oplan Tokhang” and extrajudicial killings during the presidency of Rodrigo Duterte.
